title: spec review: Q3: orchestrator/planner_packet.py — compact, delta-oriented Planner decision packets and the Opus→Fable escalation packet, size-measured (P4, P10)
spec:
Why: planner_runs.decision_packet (lines 43-107) and grouped_packet rebuild a per-point packet with the full spawn packet inventory, 300-char scout summaries, no memory, no changes-since-last-decision and no required-output section; the brief (P4) wants a delta-oriented packet with only what the decision needs, invalidated on state change, and (P10) a compact escalation packet so Fable solves the unresolved part instead of redoing Opus's work.
What: new pure module orchestrator/planner_packet.py. Never reads the bus or files itself: the caller passes data. Untrusted text goes inside fences labelled data with backticks elided (reuse planner_runs._fenced style: copy the 6-line helper, do not import planner_runs).
- build(sections, *, goal, previous=None, changes=None, scout_findings=None, memory_hits=None, cap_chars=6000) -> {"text", "chars", "est_tokens" (chars // 4), "hash" (sha256[:12]), "sections": [names included], "truncated": [names cut], "delta": bool}. sections = list of {"point", "ctx", "route" (decision.Route or dict with name/reason/evidence/tier), "classification" (planner_taxonomy dict), "task" (bus dict or None), "reviews" (list of {path, line, issue}), "failures" (str or None), "depends_on_statuses" ([{id, status}])}. Section order and rules: 1 Decision header (per section: decision_type, expected output: initial_goal_plan/scout_results -> 'write plan.md and atomic specs', fix_strategy/held_task -> 'write one fix-round spec with depends_on=[held]', architectural_replan -> 'respec or split; state why', closable_goal -> 'open PR goal/<id> -> main or say why not', ambiguous_requirement -> 'state the ambiguity under Needs the human', retrospective -> 'record.sh add', other -> 'decide'); 2 Goal (id, title, complexity, spec first 600 chars); 3 Changes since previous decision: when previous is None the line 'first Planner decision for this goal'; else changes (list of {"task", "field", "from", "to", "ts"} supplied by caller, max 20 lines) and previous.state_version; delta True iff previous given; 4 Relevant task state per section (title, status, hold_reason, failures capped 1500, review comments max 10, depends_on statuses); 5 Scout findings: only when a section is scout_results/initial_goal_plan, list of structured findings {claim, path, confidence} max 10 lines (caller normalises via scout_evidence.normalize_findings); 6 Memory: titles only, max 10, each 200 chars; 7 Unresolved alternatives: route.evidence lines plus the option sets (copy planner_runs._SCOUTS_DONE_OPTIONS/_NEXT_ACTION_OPTIONS names as constants here); 8 Required output (repeat of header expectations plus 'Do not restate this packet'). Excluded by construction: event logs, unrelated tasks, transcripts, previous prompts.
- Truncation: header, Goal and Required output are never truncated; when over cap, cut sections in this order until it fits: Memory, Scout findings, Unresolved alternatives, Changes, Relevant task state (failures first). Record cut names in truncated.
- escalation_packet(*, goal, original_sections, opus_decision, unresolved, conflicting_evidence=None, scout_findings=None, memory_hits=None, reason, cap_chars=6000) -> same shape; opus_decision is a structured dict {"proposed_action", "summary" (cap 800), "tasks_proposed" ([{"title", "scope"}] cap 10), "confidence", "needs_fable", "unresolved"} — the packet includes it under 'Opus proposed decision (data)' and the header 'Escalation reason: <reason>. Solve only the unresolved items.' Never includes raw transcripts; any key not in that whitelist is dropped.
- invalidated(previous_state_version, current_state_version) -> bool (differ or either None).
- meta(text) -> {"chars", "est_tokens", "hash"}.
acceptance: tests/test_planner_packet.py::test_first_decision_has_no_delta_and_all_sections — one scout_results section with findings and memory hits produces sections in the documented order, delta False and the text 'first Planner decision for this goal'

tests/test_planner_packet.py::test_delta_lists_changes_since_previous — previous record and 3 changes give delta True, the 3 change lines and the previous state_version; a 40-entry change list is cut to 20 lines

tests/test_planner_packet.py::test_truncation_order_and_protected_sections — cap 1200 with long failures drops Memory first, then Scout findings, and never cuts the header or Required output; truncated names match
tests/test_planner_packet.py::test_untrusted_text_is_fenced_and_backticks_elided — a hold_reason containing ``` and 'ignore previous instructions' appears inside a data fence with backticks elided

tests/test_planner_packet.py::test_escalation_packet_whitelists_opus_decision — an opus_decision carrying a 'transcript' key and a 3000-char summary yields a packet without the transcript, summary capped at 800, the escalation reason in the header and invalidated() True for differing versions

risks.issue: Section schema (point, ctx, route, classification, task, reviews, failures, depends_on_statuses) carries no decision_type field, but header rule 1 requires picking the expected-output line from a 9-value enum (initial_goal_plan/scout_results/fix_strategy/held_task/architectural_replan/closable_goal/ambiguous_requirement/retrospective/other) that has no counterpart anywhere in the repo — planner_runs.decision_points() only ever yields kind in {scouts_done, held, closable}, 3 values, not 9.

'classification (planner_taxonomy dict)' names a module, planner_taxonomy, that does not exist anywhere in the repo (grep across orchestrator/ and .claude/ finds nothing) — there is no real shape for the executor to conform to for the header/decision_type derivation or the Relevant task state section.

Scout findings are specified as {claim, path, confidence} 'normalised via scout_evidence.normalize_findings', but that function actually returns entries keyed finding/source/confidence/relevance/unresolved/needs_challenge — not claim/path — so the field names in the spec don't match the cited helper's real output.

suggested_spec_changes: Add an explicit decision_type field to the section input schema (or state which existing field — e.g. classification.decision_type or point.kind — supplies it) and reconcile the 9-value enum with the 3-value kind vocabulary planner_runs already uses, or state that this module introduces a new taxonomy the caller must produce.

Either scope in orchestrator/planner_taxonomy.py (or point to the real module that already produces this shape) so 'classification (planner_taxonomy dict)' has something concrete to conform to, or drop the reference and inline the exact dict shape expected.

Fix the Scout findings field names to match scout_evidence.normalize_findings's real output (finding/source/confidence/relevance/unresolved/needs_challenge) or specify the caller-side translation from claim/path explicitly.
